For anyone with a passing interest in the fashion industry, it's worth a read for the name dropping alone.As became clear in the film, which chronicled the magazine's staff as they put together the 4 pound September 2007 issue, Coddington is not the Anna Wintour or Diana Vreeland type. comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
These don't need to cost any more than they already do imo. Personal feelings about inflation aside...

SSIP are basically a one-use, guaranteed outcome item. You mod your ships, and you're done. You get more ships later? Whatever, no different: buy/use for the guaranteed outcome.

But CT are a lottery. You could get what you want in 1-5 tickets, or in 100+. Maybe more. The promise of winning big keeps people coming back and paying more for the privilege of doing so. (I don't think their value should be so high, but the idle rich willingly pay more for them in bulk and thus the inflated value occurs.)

That's just my two ducats' worth, of course. Cheers.
